ambient: Something a long way out finishes, and starts again.
A direction briefly becomes the obvious one, and then does not.
description: Open, even, no horizon and no need for one. It isn't empty; it's unfurnished. Somewhere in it there's a direction that would be worth going, and the not-knowing which is peaceful rather than urgent.
name: The Wide Grey

looks: Even, all the way out, with something in it that isn't a landmark.
It has depth. You couldn't say how you know.
It's nearer in one direction and that direction moves.
objects.name: the distance

looks: They arrive slightly after you take them.
There are more of them behind you than you have taken.
They're the only thing here with edges.
objects.name: your own footsteps
